Name: cuRobo
Description: CUDA-accelerated motion generation library that solves collision-free inverse kinematics and trajectory optimization in parallel on the GPU for robot manipulators.
Citation: Sundaralingam et al., cuRobo: Parallelized Collision-Free Robot Motion Generation, ICRA 2023

Name: VAMP
Description: Vector-accelerated motion planning that packs collision checks into SIMD lanes so sampling-based planners solve manipulator queries in under a millisecond.
Citation: Thomason et al., Motions in Microseconds via Vectorized Sampling-Based Planning, ICRA 2024

Name: RAPTOR
Description: Reachability-aware trajectory optimization that certifies joint and obstacle constraints over a continuous trajectory rather than at sampled waypoints.
Citation: Zhang et al., RAPTOR: Rapid Aligned Planning of Trajectories for Online Robots, 2024

Name: CRISP
Description: Contact-rich interaction planner that reasons over simultaneous contact mode sequences and continuous motion for in-hand and extrinsic manipulation.
Citation: Wang et al., CRISP: Contact-Rich Interaction Sequence Planning, 2025
